scope: Actual OnePlus 6 Android 15 developer-backend authentication; synthetic server, native form input, real host protocol and Android vault
result: Functional protocol/lifecycle cases passed with explicit visual-capture and unrun-case limitations; not a clean UX or performance pass
source_binding: Base commit plus exact file hashes below; candidate includes uncommitted auth and Glance fixes at test time
auth_transport: Isolated Android WebView process/profile; HTTP loopback synthetic endpoint admitted only through explicit acceptance feature and exact marked profile
final_apk_passed: Expanded Glance host consent opened the isolated native auth Activity and reached authorize200.
Native Cancel returned to the same expanded card with Sign-in cancelled; no token exchange for that attempt.
Actual existing fictional-account form login from Glance completed login303, one-time PKCE exchange200 and me200.
Main Activity resumed visibly; changing the active connection invalidated the old account-bound card, returning to the ordinary Glance page.
Cold restart restored the newly connected account from the Android vault; Protected identity reached me200.
Disconnect reached logout200, cleared the active connection and displayed No account; zero ephemeral auth profiles remained.
earlier_same_lab_cases: Actual HTML registration201 and ordinary-app login303/exchange200/me200; no account or token injection.
Android15 system/IME insets corrected; native toolbar and form controls had positive reachable hierarchy bounds.
Each of seven authorization attempts started without a prior browser-session cookie (authorize_cookie204); in-attempt form requests retained their session cookie.
A controlled 45-second no-input Cancel observation showed no auth Activity, no extra authorize event and zero auth profiles across nine samples.
Second signed app showed No account; an opaque primary-app handle probe caused no additional protected endpoint request and no script error. Exact refusal text was outside the fixture viewport.
retained_failures: Initial package preparation needed an explicit existing JAVA_HOME; no tool downloads.
Initial ADB archive transfer waited on stdin closure; corrected to shell -T. Environment-only startup config was replaced with the required one-shot Intent extra.
One unrelated app foreground interruption was left untouched. One earlier unexplained later auth reopening was not reproduced during the controlled 45-second cancellation observation.
Android15 toolbar overlapped system insets before the bounded WindowInsets fix; hierarchy rechecked after correction.
Glance auth was retired during Android handoff before the unified draw/event retention fix; final APK passed both Cancel and complete callback.

Two earlier keyboard-bearing ordinary-app login returns produced black ADB captures while paired Makepad GPU captures rendered the connected app. Physical-screen visibility was not independently observed; no speculative renderer fix applied.
